thread:
alex: Heads up — CedarBridge POC just hit exec-level blocker. CISO insists on KMS BYO + signed attestation + committed throughput before they greenlight contract. Meeting set Wed 09:00 ET with CTO/CISO. Need owners and timeline.

maria: On it. Can you paste the exact asks and any deadlines?

alex: From AM/CS: 1) KMS BYO + attestation timeline 2) VPC peering + IP allowlist 3) EU-only data residency 4) committed throughput numbers + pricing delta for reserved capacity 5) security questionnaire (sections S3/S5 flagged).

jordan: POC deadline is EOM. CISO will only sign after KMS confirmation and SOC2 artifacts review. They also want a PoC runbook.

sam: For KMS BYO we need KMS provider, key ARN, rotation policy, and whether they require HSM-backed keys. Also need throughput target — what's their RPS/seq/sec? Dedicated pool can handle but need quota increase.

cleo: I'll own the SSQ + attestation. Send previous SSQ answers and SOC2 link. Need to confirm no US ingress of key material.

alex: Assigning owners: @maria KMS + runbook; @sam infra/quota; @cleo SSQ; @jordan customer comms/pricing. Can we get drafts by EOD tomorrow?

maria: Will draft KMS steps. Example config:
```yaml
kms_provider: aws-kms
key_arn: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01
key_rotation: 90d
network: vpc-endpoint
access: customer-managed
```

sam: Need preferred region and CIDR from customer. For throughput ~400 seq/sec mixed, recommend reserved p4d x2 for headroom. Pricing delta ~+40% vs hosted per-token for dedicated.

jordan: Customer prefers eu-west-1. I'll confirm CIDR and send PoC schedule draft. Pricing ask: can we offer short trial credit + committed discount? Need numbers from finance.

alex: @tara finance — can you confirm committed pricing options (3mo/6mo) and any setup waiver?

deploy-bot: notice: Dedicated pool provisioning typically 48–72h after request.

maria: SSQ note: S3 access = 'no direct customer S3; ingest pipeline handles uploads; encryption at rest enabled'. I'll add to SSQ draft.

sam: VPC peering will need a network ticket. Opening NET-4523 now, tagging infra.

jordan: Sent meeting invite to CedarBridge CTO/CISO Wed 09:00 ET. Agenda: KMS, VPC, Pricing, Contract timeline. Please add any docs to the thread.

tara: We can offer 20% discount for a 3-month committed minimum; waive $10k onboarding for enterprise. I'll DM a term sheet.

sam: Note — egress >5TB/mo will add egress charges. Flagging for pricing.

cleo: I'll review SOC2 and flag missing artifacts. If customer requests attestation beyond docs, we'll schedule a call.

maria: Uploading PoC runbook draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/cedarbridge-poc (draft). Includes steps for key rotation, connection testing, and sample IAM policy.

jordan: Customer asked if Redwood supports HSM-backed keys with customer-managed rotation — confirmed yes, need key ARN and policy.

alex: TL;DR owners & deadlines: Maria (KMS/SSQ) — EOD tomorrow; Sam (infra/quota/ticket) — 48h; Cleo (SSQ review) — EOD tomorrow; Jordan (customer confirmations/pricing) — EOD today; Tara (finance terms) — EOD today. If we hit blockers we will escalate to execs. :thumbsup:

cleo: Got it, I'll prioritize.

sam: NET-4523 created: https://tickets.redwood.example/NET-4523 — request fast-track.

jordan: I'll post meeting notes in this thread after Wed.

alex: Thanks team. Please paste final assets in this thread before EOD tomorrow so I can update the execs.
